mapper.sql: OUTBOX_ID, AGENCY_CD, TX_TYPE, BIZ_KEY, STAT_CD, ATTEMPTS, NEXT_TRY_DT, LAST_ERROR, CREATED_DT, SENT_DT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EXT_OUTBOX (AGENCY_CD, TX_TYPE, BIZ_KEY, PAYLOAD, STAT_CD, ATTEMPTS, NEXT_TRY_DT, CREATED_DT) VALUES (#{agency}, #{txType}, #{bizKey}, #{payload}, '10', 0, #{now}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (AGENCY_CD, TX_TYPE, BIZ_KEY) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT STAT_CD FROM TB_EXT_OUTBOX WHERE OUTBOX_ID = #{outboxId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EXT_OUTBOX SET STAT_CD = '10', ATTEMPTS = 0, NEXT_TRY_DT = #{now} WHERE OUTBOX_ID = #{outboxId}
mapper.select: SELECT OUTBOX_ID, AGENCY_CD, TX_TYPE, BIZ_KEY, PAYLOAD, ATTEMPTS FROM TB_EXT_OUTBOX WHERE STAT_CD = '10' AND NEXT_TRY_DT <= #{now} ORDER BY NEXT_TRY_DT, OUTBOX_ID LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EXT_OUTBOX SET STAT_CD = '20', ATTEMPTS = #{attempts}, SENT_DT = #{now}, LAST_ERROR = NULL WHERE OUTBOX_ID = #{outboxId}
UPDATE TB_EXT_OUTBOX SET STAT_CD = #{statCd}, ATTEMPTS = #{attempts}, NEXT_TRY_DT = #{nextTryDt}, LAST_ERROR = #{lastError} WHERE OUTBOX_ID = #{outboxId}
